questions.question: What is a scarcity tactic in advertising? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• What is a scarcity tactic in advertising?
  • Creating artificial urgency to increase demand –
  • e.g., “Limited stock”, “Offer ends today”.
  • Psychological trigger of FOMO (Fear of Missing
  • Out).
